MOObject: multiOmicDataSet object class for MOSuite

Source: R/MOObject-package.R
MOObject-package.Rd

MOObject defines the multiOmicDataSet object class which is used in MOSuite for differential RNA-seq and multi-omics analyses. Separating the MOObject class definition from MOSuite allows for lightweight installations in downstream workflows. See the website for more information: https://ccbr.github.io/MOObject/. See the MOSuite website for the most comprehensive documentation: https://ccbr.github.io/MOSuite/.
